items.proposed: MGMT role exploratory_correlative (not an eligibility/selection biomarker)
items.reason: Entry requires only that testing be ordered ('must have ... MGMT methylation status ordered at time of registration'), not a particular status, so MGMT is not an entry requirement on the tumour's value; any_molecular_selection false. No candidate exists, so the outcome is moot.

note: Diagnostic imaging trial (gadolinium, 18F-fluciclovine only); excluded at S6 regardless. MGMT 'status ordered' is testing only (D31-A8, exploratory_correlative). Exclusion reason set to excluded_intervention_type under the clarified D31-C1 (diagnostic procedures are under test).

harmonisation.reason: Diagnostic procedures (DSC-MRI, MR spectroscopy, PET) are the interventions under test, and the clarified D31-C1 uses excluded_intervention_type whenever a non-drug intervention, including a diagnostic one, is under test.
